execution.raw_artifacts: oracle-runs/reports/aggregate-dashboard/ (ignored; no artifact exists for this static-only case)

limitations: The bounded plan and command templates are retained for a future pinned differential run; this corpus was not executed through Java, JMeter, a report generator, or a subprocess, so no process exit is asserted.
The XML and CSV files are original JTL-shaped inputs. Their descriptors are exact static expectations, not promoted oracle evidence.

The listener treats SampleCount=2/ErrorCount=1 as a StatisticalSampleResult aggregate: t=600 is a 600 ms total over two represented samples, so its effective elapsed value is 300 ms per sample; bytes remain per-row totals.

The dashboard consumes rows, not StatisticalSampleResult weights: the seven input rows remain seven dashboard observations, and the absent elapsed field is the deterministic zero value used by the report reader.

The listener uses Math.round(count * percentile) weighted rank and weighted APDEX S=4/T=1/F=3; the dashboard uses the explicit LEGACY p*(n+1) estimator over its bounded FIFO window and row APDEX S=3/T=1/F=3. Their expected values remain separate.
The empty input uses the declared empty_combined_report_surface shape variant; non-empty listener and dashboard descriptors use separate nonempty_report_surface documents.
